selection: none; single fixed engineering configuration chosen after r2 output truncation, not by quality
failure_policy: No retries/replacements. Provider or unknown status halts whole cohort. Invalid planner skips dependent coder; no substitute plan.
acceptance: 18 new planner contexts and 18 new coder fixtures; each at least 17 complete valid outputs; coder executable under bounded Program. 6 new E2E contexts; at least5/6 complete pairs. Same gates as r2.
prompt_policy: Unchanged discovery.SYSTEM/planner_prompt/coder_prompt; new synthetic contexts include two recent records in half of cases to reflect search prompt length. No generated task coordinate or hidden result is loaded.
runtime_policy: Single foreground supervised batch; one request at a time. Raw persistence and no repeat after durable response.
provenance: r2 had 14/18 planner acceptance, all four failures finish_reason=length. r3 is a separate fixed-cap engineering revision, not pooled, no claim of superiority from increased cap.
stop_rule: If r3 gates fail, stop further calibration/search expansion in this round; do not keep raising caps until a positive result. If all gates pass, freeze a separate S1 protocol.
